notes: GitHub web UI. Tools assume you're on a repo / PR / issue page. Use /page_info first to confirm.

tools.description: On a repo's issues page (or any page), return the list of visible issues with title, number, author, labels, comment count. Caller should navigate to /<owner>/<repo>/issues first if needed.
Summarize the current PR page: title, state, author, files changed, additions, deletions, comments. Must be on a /pull/N URL.
On a repo root page, return the visible file/folder list.
